prompts.nice-to-meet-you: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Generate one landscape photographic contact sheet used as a 2-by-2 scene atlas for a beginner English conversation. EXACTLY four equal rectangular photos in a mathematically centered 2 by 2 grid, full bleed without gutters, borders, text, numbers, logos, letterforms or watermarks. The four images will be cropped using the horizontal and vertical midpoint lines, so each quadrant must be an independent complete horizontal shot and faces/hands must stay away from all seams. Every photo shows the same two respective participants in consistent clothes, same age and identity throughout. Natural warm daylight, realistically candid expressions, medium shots, contemporary modest clothing, meaningful learner-friendly visible objects, no physical contact required. Top left is scene 1, top right is scene 2, bottom left is scene 3, bottom right is scene 4. Outside a small adult evening language classroom, young adult Arab man Omar wears an olive shirt with a navy backpack and young adult Arab woman Sara wears a muted lavender hijab and an oatmeal cardigan, holding a light blue notebook. They have just met, not old friends. 1: Omar waves and lightly gestures to himself while Sara holds her notebook and listens at the entrance. 2: Sara smiles and gestures to herself while introducing herself, notebook in other hand, Omar listens. 3: both smiling pleasantly toward one another near an indoor bench, acknowledging introductions with gentle open hands, no handshake. 4: Sara gestures toward the open classroom door and both begin to head inside, with rows of desks visible beyond door. Clear blue notebook, backpack, door, desk details where relevant.

At an ordinary daytime bakery pickup counter, adult Arab man Omar in a navy jacket with dark short hair is the customer and adult Arab woman Sara in a simple teal hijab and dark apron is the bakery clerk. Strong uncluttered silhouettes, no menus or paper text.

conversations.goalEn: Introduce yourselves and say goodbye before class.
conversations.goalAr: تعارفا ثم تبادلا الوداع قبل الصف.

stages.en: Say your name and ask theirs
stages.ar: قل اسمك واسأل عن اسم الآخر
stages.purposeEn: Say your name and ask theirs.
stages.purposeAr: قل اسمك واسأل عن اسم الآخر.

image.en: Omar waves as he introduces himself outside the classroom.
image.ar: يلوّح عمر وهو يعرّف بنفسه أمام غرفة الصف.

stages.en: Introduce yourself and greet the other person
stages.purposeEn: Introduce yourself and greet the other person.

image.en: Sara gestures to herself while holding a blue notebook.
image.ar: تشير سارة إلى نفسها وهي تحمل دفترًا أزرق.

image.en: Omar and Sara smile at one another beside a bench.
image.ar: يبتسم عمر وسارة أحدهما للآخر بجوار مقعد.

image.en: Sara gestures toward the open classroom door while Omar follows.
image.ar: تشير سارة إلى غرفة الصف من الباب المفتوح بينما يتبعها عمر.

conversations.goalEn: Ask for repetition and a slower pace while picking up an order.
conversations.goalAr: اطلب إعادة العبارة والتحدّث ببطء عند استلام طلبك.

image.en: Omar leans closer to hear Sara at the bakery counter.
image.ar: يميل عمر إلى الأمام ليسمع سارة عند منضدة المخبز.

image.en: Sara points to the paper bag to show the order is ready.
image.ar: تشير سارة إلى الكيس الورقي لتوضّح أن الطلب جاهز.

stages.en: Ask the speaker to slow down
stages.ar: اطلب من المتحدثة أن تتكلّم ببطء
stages.purposeEn: Ask the speaker to slow down.
stages.purposeAr: اطلب من المتحدثة أن تتكلّم ببطء.

image.en: Omar gestures gently to ask Sara to speak more slowly.
image.ar: يشير عمر بيده برفق طالبًا من سارة التحدّث ببطء أكبر.

stages.en: Listen again and collect the order
stages.purposeEn: Listen again and collect the order.

image.en: Sara repeats the message and holds out the paper bag.
image.ar: تكرّر سارة العبارة وتمدّ الكيس الورقي نحو عمر.

conversations.goalEn: Greet a friend you know, ask how they are, and say goodbye.
conversations.goalAr: حيِّ صديقًا تعرفه، واسأل عن حاله، ثم ودّعه.

image.en: Omar waves as Sara approaches along the park path.
image.ar: يلوّح عمر لسارة وهي تقترب على ممرّ الحديقة.

stages.en: Return the greeting and ask how they are
stages.ar: ردّ على التحية واسأل عن الحال
stages.purposeEn: Return the greeting and ask how they are.
stages.purposeAr: ردّ على التحية واسأل عن الحال.

image.en: Sara returns Omar’s greeting while standing near the bench.
image.ar: تردّ سارة على تحية عمر وهي واقفة قرب المقعد.

image.en: Omar gives a farewell wave as he turns toward the path.
image.ar: يلوّح عمر مودّعًا وهو يستدير نحو الممرّ.

image.en: Sara waves back while Omar walks away along the park path.
image.ar: تردّ سارة التلويح بينما يبتعد عمر على ممرّ الحديقة.

conversations.goalEn: Ask for the restaurant check, thank the server, and say goodbye.
conversations.goalAr: اطلب فاتورة المطعم، واشكر مقدّمة الخدمة، ثم ودّعها.

image.en: Omar asks the server for the check beside an empty plate.
image.ar: يطلب عمر الفاتورة وأمامه طبق فارغ.

image.en: Sara places the black bill folder and receipt on the table.
image.ar: تضع سارة حامل الفاتورة الأسود والإيصال على الطاولة.

image.en: Omar stands and thanks Sara, with the bill folder still on the table.
image.ar: يقف عمر ويشكر سارة، وحامل الفاتورة ما زال على الطاولة.

image.en: Sara waves goodbye as Omar leaves through the café door.
image.ar: تلوّح سارة مودّعة عمر وهو يغادر من باب المقهى.

conversations.goalEn: Ask for the restroom, understand where it is, and thank the person who helped.
conversations.goalAr: اسأل عن دورة المياه، وافهم موقعها، واشكر من ساعدك.

stages.purposeEn: Ask where the restroom is in the library.
stages.purposeAr: اسأل عن مكان دورة المياه في المكتبة.

image.en: Omar asks Sara for directions in a library lobby near the elevator.
image.ar: يطلب عمر من سارة إرشاده إلى المكان في بهو المكتبة قرب المصعد.

stages.en: Explain that it is beside the elevator
stages.purposeEn: Explain that it is beside the elevator.

image.en: Sara points toward the side door beside the elevator.
image.ar: تشير سارة إلى الباب الجانبي بجوار المصعد.

stages.en: Thank the person for their help
stages.purposeEn: Thank the person for their help.

image.en: Omar thanks Sara as they stand near the elevator.
image.ar: يشكر عمر سارة وهما يقفان قرب المصعد.

image.en: Sara gestures warmly as Omar walks toward the side door.
image.ar: تردّ سارة بإشارة ودّية بينما يتّجه عمر نحو الباب الجانبي.
